label: First-party search-economy arm: extractor sound, code_node embed text too thin for NL recall evidence chunk 2
title: First-party search-economy arm: extractor sound, code_node embed text too thin for NL recall evidence chunk 2
summary: RESULT — first-party (shipped embed text): mean recall 0.385 / 1295 tok / 619 tok-per-correct / 6-of-13 hits. This is BELOW the expected ~0.58, but token economy is the best of all arms. Honest diagnosis: NOT an extractor problem and NOT a fetch problem — it is a LOCATE/ranking problem. The shipped codeNodeEmbedText (lib/node-tags.js:34) embeds only `name — signature in file` because the extractor never populates `summary`. That thin text cosine-matches NL queries weakly: e.g. compileSearchContext ranked #20 (cos 0.527), gateTask #18 (cos 0.501), buildQueue/nextSlice/appendVerdict not in top-40 — generic-named helpers in big files (overlay.js, daemon.js) crowd the top-6, so the relevant symbols never get fetched.
